fields.small_group_and_one_to_one_sessions_for_: Small-group and one-to-one sessions for people who want to move well, not just move more. Six mats. One teacher. Every body welcome.
fields.first_class_10_no_membership_cancel_anyt: First class £10 · No membership · Cancel anytime

fields.most_people_don_t_need_a_harder_workout_: Most people don't need a harder workout. They need a practice they'll still be doing in ten years.
fields.pulse_is_built_around_controlled_precise: Pulse is built around controlled, precise movement — spine mobility, deep core, breath. Sessions stay small so every cue is yours, and every progression is paced to your body rather than the room.
fields.whether_you_re_rebuilding_after_injury_t: Whether you're rebuilding after injury, training around a desk job, or coming back to movement after a long pause, you'll start where you are and be shown exactly where to go next.

fields.i_found_pilates_in_the_middle_of_a_back_: I found Pilates in the middle of a back injury that took two years to understand. What fixed it wasn't intensity — it was attention. That's the thing I teach now.
fields.twelve_years_of_practice_six_of_teaching: Twelve years of practice, six of teaching, and a studio small enough that I know your name, your knees and your Tuesday schedule. I keep classes to six people because that's the number where I can actually see everyone.

fields.no_contracts_class_packs_never_expire_wi: No contracts. Class packs never expire within twelve months.

sessions.name: Foundations

sessions.name: Flow
sessions.desc: Continuous, full-body sequencing for people who know the repertoire and want to be worked.

sessions.name: Restore
sessions.desc: Slow mat and prop work for stiff mornings, long desk weeks and recovery days.

sessions.name: One to one
sessions.desc: A programme built for your body — injury, pregnancy, sport or simply faster progress.

fields.choose_a_time_from_the_live_timetable_be: Choose a time from the live timetable. Beginners, start with Foundations — it's designed for a first-ever session.
fields.a_two_minute_health_form_injuries_pregna: A two-minute health form. Injuries, pregnancy, hypermobility — I plan around it before you arrive.
fields.mats_blocks_bands_and_grip_socks_are_her: Mats, blocks, bands and grip socks are here. Arrive five minutes early and I'll walk you through the reformer.

audience.title: You sit down for a living
audience.body: And your hips, neck and lower back have started making that clear.

audience.title: You're rebuilding after something
audience.body: An injury, a surgery, a birth, a long stretch of doing nothing. We start below your limit.

audience.title: You already train hard
audience.body: Pilates is the control work that makes the running, lifting or climbing hold together.

audience.title: You want to be strong at sixty
audience.body: This is a practice, not a programme. It scales with you for decades.

fields.studio_closed_thursdays_and_sundays_one_: Studio closed Thursdays and Sundays. One-to-ones by arrangement.

faqs.q: I've never done Pilates. Where do I start?
faqs.a: Foundations. It's built for people who've never seen a reformer — we go slowly through the springs, the straps and the basic positions, and nobody in the room is racing you.

faqs.q: What should I wear and bring?
faqs.a: Fitted leggings or shorts and a top that stays put when you're upside down. Grip socks are required and I keep spare pairs at £8. Everything else is provided.

faqs.q: Can I come if I'm pregnant or postnatal?
faqs.a: Yes. I'm pre and postnatal trained and will adapt the session. If you're in your first trimester or less than six weeks postpartum, message me first so we can plan it properly.
Cancel more than twelve hours before and the class returns to your pack. Under twelve hours the space is usually impossible to fill, so the class is used.

faqs.q: Do I need to commit to a membership?
faqs.a: No. Buy single classes or a pack of five or ten, valid twelve months. There's no rolling contract to escape from.

fields.a_free_video_sequence_for_stiff_backs_an: A free video sequence for stiff backs and desk shoulders. Sent once, no drip campaign.

fields.six_mats_a_session_most_weeks_they_go_by: Six mats a session. Most weeks they go by Friday.
